title: 猴山仔 Kâu-san-á
mood: starving, furious and half laughing at itself
subject: a macaque on Kaohsiung's Chaishan snatching your pork-chop lunchbox before the first bite
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien melodic punk, a three-chord festival punk anthem. Two overdriven electric guitars down-picking eighth-note power chords, palm-muted in the verses and open and ringing in the choruses, with one single-note melodic lead guitar hook in the intro; electric bass locked to root eighths with the kick; drums in a straight two-and-four rock beat in the verses that switches to a double-time skate-punk beat in the choruses, with crash-ride wash and short snare-roll fills into each chorus. Live-room sound, dry and loud, guitars wide and the lead vocal forward and unprocessed. Raw shouted-sung male chest voice with clear Taigi diction, and the whole band shouting the chorus lines together as a gang vocal. 178 BPM, E major. Starving, furious and half laughing at itself. No guitar solo, no blues bends, no surf-rock reverb, no synth, no autotune, no enka-style weeping, no slow ballad breakdown.
lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜日 蹈柴山 規身軀汗
半山腰 坐落來 便當掀開
排骨飯 加一粒滷卵
箸 猶未提起來

[Pre-Chorus]
樹仔頂 一个影 跳落來
我的排骨 已經佇伊的手內

[Chorus]
猴山仔!猴山仔!你轉來!
彼塊排骨 我等規早起
猴山仔!猴山仔!你敢有咧看
我徛佇山路 大聲喝

[Verse]
伊坐佇樹椏 一喙一喙
滷卵 擲落來 輾到我的跤
牌仔寫 莫飼猴山仔
我無飼 是伊家己提

[Chorus]
猴山仔!猴山仔!你轉來!
彼塊排骨 賰一枝骨頭
猴山仔!猴山仔!你敢有咧看
我共白飯食甲清氣溜溜

[Outro]
伊佇樹頂 金金咧看我
下擺 我欲紮兩个便當
